question: Should Mitragyna speciosa be recommended for: self-treatment of pain / opioid withdrawal symptoms?

records.notes: NIH LiverTox documents that kratom (Mitragyna speciosa) causes clinically apparent acute liver injury, typically with a 2-6 week latency to onset, and states that overdose of kratom can result in seizures, coma, and death; a prospective case series confirmed kratom as the causal agent using standardized causality assessment.
records.source_title: Kratom - LiverTox: Clinical and Research Information on Drug-Induced Liver Injury
records.study_design: Clinical reference compendium / case series review
